title: Moving to New Orleans in 1894 and the ragtime music he found
summary: He came to New Orleans in January 1894; the music was rag, with Peyton the accordion player downtown and Bolden coming up after learning from Manuel Hall.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: When did you move to New Orleans?
When I come to New Orleans?
And what kind of music were they playing here then?
Well, they were playing all rag, not particular rag, too many rag music. But they had rag music downtown there, Peyton and them.
Peyton, he used to be an accordion player. And then Buddy Bowling come up. And Buddy Bowling learned how to play college on the manual hall. And he got to be famous himself.
